verdict.rationale: Digits publishes both a top-level llms.txt (digits.com/llms.txt) and a developer-docs llms.txt (developer.digits.com/llms.txt), confirmed live via probe with HTTP 200, plus .md mirrors of every doc page — exactly the agent-oriented docs format the story asks for. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that an agent successfully consumed the llms.txt end-to-end (only first-party probes and docs are available).
